name: intent
description: Intent-based task resolution. When stuck, facing ambiguity, or about to ask a clarifying question, first recover the task's underlying intent from available context - the latest prompt, earlier prompts, project goals, plans, and prior corrections - then answer low-risk questions from that intent and make intent-aligned decisions. Escalate to the user only when the ambiguity is material, cannot be resolved from context, and would make proceeding unreliable.
